title: Kissed Polish Praline Dumplings
description: A kid-friendly Polish dish featuring praline and herbal flavors, cooked to perfection on a salt block, this macrobiotic-friendly dessert is both chewy and delicious, with a French twist from the praline, creating an emulsified treat that is sure to please, making it a great option for a fun and tasty dessert
instructions: Preheat the salt block in the oven at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, praline paste, honey, and dried mint leaves.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg, milk, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Place the dumplings on the preheated salt block and cook for 12 minutes.
Serve the dumplings warm, garnished with additional dried mint leaves if desired.
